title: The Jewel Case
subtitle: A Stolen Necklace and a Master Sleuth
summary: When a renowned jeweller's priceless necklace vanishes without a trace, the ingenious Byomkesh Bakshi is called upon to solve the baffling crime. As secrets unravel and suspects emerge, will Byomkesh uncover the elusive truth behind the jewel case? Dive into a classic mystery where every clue counts.
